meta.note: Real 2026 CSRVIII (Central Section Region VIII) Speedo Sectionals at Columbia, MO qualifying times — Arkansas Swimming's actual Sectional meet. Source: official meet book, 'Speedo Sectionals at Columbia – Spring 2026', meet held March 12-15, 2026, sanctioned by Missouri Valley Swimming. Qualifying window ran through the March 9, 2026 entry deadline (so this meet has already happened this season — treat as a current benchmark, not an upcoming entry). These are 'Open' standards — not split by 2-year age group like USA-S AAAA/AAA/etc. Priority = faster cut, guarantees an individual entry; Bonus = slower cut, grants a bonus-event entry (fewer total events allowed, extra fee). The meet itself is contested in SCY; the LCM column is the meet's own 'equivalent long-course qualifying time' used as alternate entry proof, not necessarily identical to a dedicated Summer (LCM) Sectional's native standard — replace with a real Summer meet book if/when available for a more precise LCM comparison. KNOWN GAP: 50 Back, 50 Breast, and 50 Fly were omitted — the source PDF's qualifying-times table has those rows populated with values identical to the corresponding 100-distance event (e.g. '50 Fly' and '100 Fly' both list 52.89/53.89 SCY), which isn't physically plausible for a 50 vs a 100. This looks like a copy/paste error in the meet host's document. Rather than publish wrong 50-stroke cuts, they're left out until a corrected source turns up. No Zone data: Central Zone's age-group championship (the 'Zone' meet) is limited to 14-and-under swimmers, so it doesn't apply to Jack at age 15 — Sectionals (this document) is the relevant multi-LSC benchmark for his current age.
